Once upon a time a shoemaker called Hans lived with his wife Greta above their little shoe shop.
A sleepy ginger cat dozed by the door.
Hans and Greta made good, strong shoes, and they were kind to everyone who came in.
One snowy evening Hans and Greta were very tired, and there was only enough leather left for one more pair of shoes.
Hans cut it out and laid the pieces on the workbench.
We'll sew them in the morning,
said Hans, with a great big yawn.
That night, while Hans and Greta were fast asleep upstairs, a happy little sound came from the workshop below.
Tap, tap, tap!
Stitch, stitch, stitch!
In the morning Hans came downstairs.
On the workbench stood a pair of shiny new shoes, sewn with tiny, perfect stitches.
Greta, come and look!
said Hans.
Who made these?
Oh, what beautiful shoes!
said Greta.
That very morning a lady in a purple coat came into the shop.
She tried on the new shoes, and they fit just right.
She loved them so much that she paid a very good price.
Now Hans could buy leather for two more pairs!
After that, every evening Hans cut out more leather and left it on the workbench.
And every night the happy little sound came back.
Every morning there were more new shoes, and soon the little shop was full of happy customers.
One evening Greta looked at the new leather on the workbench, all cut out and ready.
Somebody is being very kind to us,
Let's stay up tonight and see who it is, so we can say thank you.
What a lovely idea,
So that night Hans and Greta didn't go to bed.
They snuggled under a blanket in the big armchair in the corner of the workshop, with the cat on their laps.
The moon shone in on the workbench.
They waited and waited, and Hans tried very hard not to yawn.
At midnight two tiny elves came skipping in through the cat flap.
Nib wore a pointy red hat, and Nob wore a pointy green hat.
Their little feet were bare, and their tunics were thin and patched.
Nib and Nob hopped up onto the workbench and got to work, quick as a wink.
sang Nib, with her tiny hammer.
sang Nob, with his tiny needle.
Hans and Greta watched from the armchair and smiled.
When the last shoe was finished, Hans and Greta came over to the workbench.
Thank you, little friends,
You've helped us so much!
Nib and Nob looked up and giggled.
We love making shoes for kind people,
said Nib.
See you tomorrow night!
said Nob, and he waved.
The next day Greta sewed two tiny warm coats and two woolly scarves.
Hans made two pairs of tiny boots, the smallest he had ever made.
Now their little toes will be warm and cosy,
It's our turn to help them,
That night the presents sat waiting on the workbench.
Hans and Greta waited in the armchair.
At midnight Nib and Nob came skipping in through the cat flap.
Look, Nob! Presents!
Are they for us?
said Nob.
Yes, they're all for you!
Nib twirled round in her new red coat, and Nob stamped his tiny new boots.
They danced round and round on the workbench.
Our toes are warm and cosy!
Thank you, Hans! Thank you, Greta!
Now we're warm, we can go and help other kind people too,
Goodbye, Hans! Goodbye, Greta!
Hans and Greta waved from the door as the elves skipped away over the moonlit snow.
Goodbye, little friends!
When someone is kind to you, you can be kind to someone else.
